# Vendored Parser Provenance

- Upstream: https://github.com/D3FEKT/ForzaTechStudio
- Commit: `4f373c5fb192551ce5249e320dd79b1399b693ca`
- License: MIT, preserved in `LICENSE`
- Imported: 2026-08-09

Included components are limited to `ForzaTools.Bundles`, `ForzaTools.Shared`,
`DurangoTypes`, and `ModelImporter.cs`. KFPS uses them only to parse local
modelbin geometry owned by the user running the application. Upstream UI,
editors, textures, materials, conversion tools, and assets are not included.
